# The Independent

> > British digital news publication covering breaking news, politics, culture, travel, and lifestyle with expert analysis and product reviews.

The Independent delivers comprehensive coverage of global events including Iran-US relations, UK politics featuring figures like Keir Starmer, and international affairs. The site includes dedicated sections for travel guides, IndyBest product reviews, entertainment coverage, and lifestyle content.

## Key Topics

- Iran-US conflict
- Donald Trump
- Middle East crisis
- Strait of Hormuz
- Oil prices and supply disruption
- UK politics and Keir Starmer
- NHS and healthcare
- Travel guides and city breaks
- Product reviews (IndyBest)
- Entertainment and music
- Political cartoons
- Iraq and Basra
- International news coverage
- BBQ and outdoor cooking reviews
- European travel destinations

## Breaking News & Politics

- [Iran-Trump war latest: Oil prices soar again after two Iraqi tankers struck in suspected Iranian attack](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/iraq-israeli-basra-american-lebanon-b2936876.html): Iran-US conflict coverage: Trump claims victory, tanker attacks in Hormuz
- ['Perilous' financial position of NHS trusts laid bare as £780m deficit revealed](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/health/nhs-deficit-finances-kings-fund-b2936561.html): King's Fund reveals £780m NHS deficit impacting patient care and jobs
- [Widow of Haiti president describes his killing at US trial of four charged with conspiracy](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/jovenel-moise-haiti-miami-men-portauprince-b2936752.html): Martine Moïse testifies in Miami trial over Jovenel Moïse assassination
- [Browse a gallery of The Independent's daily cartoon](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/the-independent-daily-cartoon-b2481312.html): Dave Brown's political cartoons and editorial illustrations gallery

## Travel Guides

- [City Break Travel Guides](https://www.independent.co.uk/travel/city-guides): Expert city break guides for destinations like Washington DC and Athens
- [Amsterdam Travel](https://www.independent.co.uk/travel/europe/netherlands/amsterdam): Amsterdam hotel reviews, travel guides, bars and restaurant recommendations
- [Cornwall](https://www.independent.co.uk/travel/uk/england/cornwall): Cornwall guide featuring Tintagel Castle, St Michael's Mount, King Arthur
- [Azerbaijan](https://www.independent.co.uk/travel/asia/azerbaijan): Azerbaijan and Baku travel guide for Asia destinations
- [Black History Month](https://www.independent.co.uk/travel/safari-wildlife-nature/black-history-month): Black History Month travel content featuring safari and wildlife themes

## IndyBest Product Reviews

- [BBQs & Accessories | Charcoal and Gas BBQ reviews](https://www.independent.co.uk/extras/indybest/house-garden/bbqs-accessories): IndyBest reviews of charcoal and gas BBQs from AO, Very, John Lewis, B&Q
- [Accessories](https://www.independent.co.uk/extras/indybest/travel-outdoors/accessories): Travel deals and discount codes for Travelodge, TUI, Booking.com, Stena
